strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software kɛha Van Sales kɛ Sales Reps
strings.tierB.home.description: Software kɛha distributors: invoice kɛ receipt yɛ rep lɛ fon nɔ, van stock, shika buamɔ, routes kɛ sarai. Etsuɔ nii kɛji internet bɛ ni efeɔ sync sɛɛ mli.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Kwɛ o sales reps anɔ kɛjɛ sara klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ kɛyashi shika buamɔ naagbee lɛ
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ji cloud platform (van sales kɛ sales rep software) kɛha distribution kɛ wholesale kɔmpanii ni kɛ sales reps tsuɔ nii yɛ gbɛ nɔ. Reps lɛ feɔ invoice kɛ receipt yɛ amɛ fon nɔ ni amɛprintɔ, amɛkwɛɔ van stock nɔ ni amɛŋmaa amɛsarai; ni managers (nɔkwɛlɔi) naa sales, shika ni abua kɛ nyɔmɔ ni yɔɔ customer fɛɛ customer nɔ yɛ be ni ebaa lɛ nɔŋŋ.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice kɛjɛ rep lɛ fon nɔ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Rep lɛ feɔ invoice lɛ yɛ customer lɛ shop lɛ shinaa naa, ni ekɛ Bluetooth thermal printer printɔ dani ejɛ shop lɛ mli.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Shika buamɔ kɛ customers anyɔmɔ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Shika fɛɛ ni awoɔ lɛ naa receipt kɛ enamba, ni akɛbɔ invoice ni ewoɔ lɛ he, ni customer lɛ nyɔmɔ kɛ statement lɛ tsakeɔ amrɔ nɔŋŋ.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Van stock nɔkwɛmɔ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Akwɛɔ van fɛɛ van stock nɔ nii kome kome: nɔ ni awo mli, nɔ ni ahɔɔ, nɔ ni akɛku sɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ, no hewɔ kɛji nɔ ko laaje lɛ, onaa lɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Routes kɛ sarai
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Aŋmaa sara fɛɛ sara kɛ location, be kɛ mfonirii, ni manager lɛ naa rep fɛɛ rep route yɛ map nɔ.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Etsuɔ nii kɛji internet bɛ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Reps hɔɔ nii kɛyaa nɔ kɛji network bɛ po. Woji lɛ mɛɔ yɛ fon lɛ nɔ, ni kɛji network lɛ ku esɛɛ ba lɛ, amɛyaa server nɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ, ni ekome po yaaa shii enyɔ.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard kɛha managers
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sales, shika ni abua, nibii ni akɛku sɛɛ, stock kɛ rep fɛɛ rep nitsumɔ, fɛɛ yɛ he kome, kɛ roles kɛ permissions kɛha user fɛɛ user.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Kɛɛ wɔ bɔ ni ohɔɔ nii
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Bi quote loo to kpee. Wɔbaakwɛ o reps, o routes, o nibii kɛ invoice ni ohiaa.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: To o kɔmpani lɛ gbɛjianɔ
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Wo o nibii, amɛ jara, customers kɛ reps lɛ system lɛ mli, ni owo o maŋ shika kɛ tax rate yɛ settings lɛ mli.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tsu reps lɛ kɛya gbɛ nɔ
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Reps kɛ app lɛ woɔ amɛ Android loo iPhone nɔ, amɛwoɔ nibii amɛ van mli, ni amɛjeɔ shishi amɛhɔɔ nii, amɛprintɔ ni amɛbuaa shika.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Kwɛ gbi lɛ bɔ ni eyaa nɔ
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard lɛ tsɔɔ sales, shika ni abua, van stock kɛ sarai yɛ be ni reps lɛ yɔɔ gbɛ nɔ lɛ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ji cloud platform ni akɛkwɛɔ sales reps anɔ yɛ distribution kɛ wholesale kɔmpanii amli. Ekwɛɔ van sales, route sales, pre-sales (order ni aheɔ dani nibii lɛ baa) kɛ direct store delivery (DSD) nɔ. Reps kɛ amɛ fon feɔ invoice, amɛprintɔ, amɛbuaa shika ni amɛŋmaa sarai, ni managers kɛjɛ web dashboard nɔ kwɛɔ sales, shika ni abua, van stock kɛ customers anyɔmɔ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales tsuɔ nii kɛji internet bɛ?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Hɛɛ. Rep app lɛ tsuɔ nii kɛyaa nɔ kɛji internet bɛ: reps feɔ invoice kɛ receipt ni amɛprintɔ, amɛŋmaa sarai ni amɛkɛ customers hee woɔ system lɛ mli, ni kɛji network lɛ ku esɛɛ ba lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yaa server nɔ automatically, ni ekome po yaaa shii enyɔ. Nɔ kome pɛ yɔɔ srɔto yɛ Saudi Arabia: kɔmpanii ni amɛgbele e-invoicing integration lɛ hiaa internet yɛ be ni amɛfeɔ invoice loo return lɛ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales sɔmɔɔ distribution kɔmpanii yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli. Kɔmpani fɛɛ kɔmpani woɔ emaŋ shika kɛ tax rate yɛ kɔmpani lɛ diɛŋtsɛ settings lɛ mli, ni akɛ amɛ feɔ invoice, receipt kɛ reports. FieldSales yɔɔ Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, ni ojeɔ shishi yɛ internet nɔ: wɔ kɛ bo wɔtsuɔ nii kɛtsɔ kpeei, WhatsApp kɛ remote support nɔ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales nyɛɔ ebɔɔ maŋ nɔyeli e-invoicing systems ahe?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Wɔfiɔ Phase 2 integration kɛ ZATCA Fatoora platform lɛ sɛɛ. Enɛ kɔɔ kɔmpanii ni yɔɔ Saudi Arabia lɛ ahe. Yɛ maji krokomɛi amli, Ghana hu, FieldSales kɛ o maŋ shika kɛ o tax rate feɔ invoice. Integration kɛ maŋ lɛ nɔyeli e-invoicing system lɛ yɔɔ kɛji obi, shi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, wɔ kɛ bo wɔbaakwɛ nɔ ni nakai maŋ lɛ mlai biɔ. Wɔwoŋ shi ko yɛ mlai ahe yɛ maji ni jeee Saudi Arabia lɛ amli.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Mɛɛ wiemɔi amli FieldSales app lɛ yɔɔ?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: FieldSales app lɛ interface yɔɔ Arabik wiemɔ, Blɔfo, Frɛnshi, Tɔki wiemɔ kɛ Chaina wiemɔ mli, ni enɛɛmɛi pɛ. Ga bɛ mli, shi Blɔfo yɔɔ mli. Reps kɛ managers nyɛɔ amɛtsakeɔ interface lɛ wiemɔ, ni anyɛɔ akɛ wiemɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ fataa wiemɔ titri lɛ he yɛ invoice ni aprintɔ lɛ nɔ. Website pages ni yɔɔ wiemɔi krokomɛi amli, tamɔ Ga page nɛɛ, ji translation ni tsɔɔ product lɛ he saji pɛ.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni maje shishi kɛ FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Bi quote, to kpee loo wie kɛ wɔ yɛ WhatsApp nɔ. Wɔbaakase bɔ ni o reps tsuɔ nii, ni wɔbaaye obua ni oto o nibii, amɛ jara, customers kɛ reps lɛ gbɛjianɔ. Reps kɛ app lɛ woɔ Android loo iPhone nɔ, ni managers kɛ browser fɛɛ browser tsuɔ web dashboard lɛ nii. Smartphone pɛ ji hardware ni ohiaa.
strings.tierB.home.cta.whatsapp: Wie kɛ wɔ yɛ WhatsApp nɔ
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: FieldSales app lɛ interface yɔɔ Arabik wiemɔ, Blɔfo, Frɛnshi, Tɔki wiemɔ kɛ Chaina wiemɔ mli; Ga bɛ mli. Pages ni yɔɔ wiemɔi krokomɛi amli lɛ tsɔɔ product lɛ he saji pɛ.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software kɛha Distributors yɛ Ghana | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales kɛ route sales software: rep lɛ kɛ fon printɔ invoice, van stock nii kome kome, shika buamɔ kɛ sarai. Etsuɔ nii kɛji internet bɛ.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software kɛha distributors kɛ wholesalers yɛ Ghana
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ji van sales software kɛha kɔmpanii ni amɛ reps kɛ van hɔɔ nii yɛ gbɛ nɔ daa gbi. Rep lɛ woɔ nibii van lɛ mli, ehɔɔ nii yɛ shop fɛɛ shop, eprintɔ invoice, ebuaa shika ni eŋmaa nibii ni akɛku sɛɛ, fɛɛ yɛ fon app kome nɔ. Manager lɛ naa nɔ ni awo van fɛɛ van mli, nɔ ni ahɔɔ, shika ni abua kɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Mɛni ji van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, ni atsɛɔ hu akɛ cash van loo route sales software, kwɛɔ nihɔɔmɔ gbɛ ko nɔ: rep lɛ kɛ stock woɔ van lɛ mli, ni ehɔɔ nii, ekɛ nibii haa, efeɔ invoice ni ebuaa shika yɛ sara kome mli. Akɛ lɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ invoice woji ni akɛ nine ŋmaa kɛ fon tsɛmɔ ni afeɔ gbɛkɛ lɛ najiaŋ. Eŋmaa nihɔɔmɔ fɛɛ, shika fɛɛ ni awo kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛku sɛɛ akɛ wolo, no hewɔ onyɛɔ okɛ stock kɛ shika toɔ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kɛha manager, ehaa sanebimɔi etɛ ahetoo gbɛkɛ fɛɛ gbɛkɛ: mɛni rep fɛɛ rep hɔɔ, shika enyiɛ rep fɛɛ rep bua, ni mɛni eshwɛ yɛ van fɛɛ van mli?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Gbi kome yɛ gbɛ nɔ
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Gbi lɛ jeɔ shishi kɛ nibii ni akɛjɛ warehouse awo van lɛ mli, ni aŋma yɛ system lɛ mli. Yɛ shop fɛɛ shop lɛ, rep lɛ gbeleɔ customer lɛ he saji, ewoɔ nibii mli kɛjɛ list loo barcode nɔ, efeɔ invoice ni ekɛ thermal printer printɔ. Akɛ receipt ŋmaa shika ni awo, ni kɛji akɛ nɔ ko ku sɛɛ lɛ, aŋmaa nɔ hewɔ ni akɛku sɛɛ lɛ. Yɛ gbi lɛ naagbee, nibii ni eshwɛ yɛ van lɛ mli lɛ, akɛyaa warehouse ekoŋŋ. Yɛ be nɛɛ fɛɛ mli, manager lɛ nyɛɔ ekwɛɔ rep fɛɛ rep sales, shika ni abua kɛ sarai yɛ web dashboard nɔ, ni ehiaaa ni etsɛ mɔ ko.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Afee lɛ kɛha hei ni network bɛ hewalɛ
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution routes yaa tsũi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi, industrial areas kɛ akrowai ni network bɛ hewalɛ yɛ. FieldSales rep app lɛ toɔ customers, nibii kɛ amɛ jara yɛ fon lɛ nɔ, no hewɔ rep lɛ nyɛɔ efeɔ woji ni eprintɔ kɛji internet bɛ po. Akɛ unique key woɔ wolo fɛɛ wolo he, no hewɔ eyaa server nɔ shi kome pɛ, kɛji akaa ekoŋŋ po. Kɔmpanii ni yɔɔ Saudi Arabia ni amɛgbele e-invoicing integration lɛ hiaa internet yɛ be ni amɛfeɔ invoices kɛ returns. Receipts, sarai kɛ customers hee tsuɔ nii kɛyaa nɔ kɛji internet bɛ kɛha amɛ hu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Shika buamɔ kɛ van nɔkwɛmɔ
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Shika ni yɔɔ gbɛ nɔ hiaa nɔkwɛmɔ tamɔ stock. Shika buamɔ fɛɛ naa receipt kɛ enamba, ni anyɛɔ akɛbɔɔ invoice ni ewoɔ lɛ he, ni customer lɛ nyɔmɔ tsakeɔ amrɔ nɔŋŋ. Abuɔ van stock nii kome kome: nɔ ni awo mli, ajie nɔ ni ahɔɔ, akɛ nibii ni akɛku sɛɛ kɛ tsakemɔi ni aŋma lɛ fata he, no hewɔ managers nyɛɔ amɛkɛtoɔ nɔ ni akane diɛŋtsɛ dani rep lɛ yaa shia. Anyɛɔ ajaa returns mli: ekpakpa, nɔ ni efite loo tsakemɔ (exchange), ni manager lɛ ji mɔ ni kpɛɔ yiŋ kɛji nibii ni akɛku sɛɛ lɛ baaku kɛya van stock ni anyɛɔ ahɔɔ lɛ mli.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Namɔ hiaa FieldSales?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales sa kɛha distributors kɛ wholesalers ni hɔɔ nibii ni ahɔɔ oya (FMCG), tamɔ niyenii, nibii ni anuɔ, nibii ni akɛfeɔ he tse kɛ gbɔmɔtso he nibii, kɛ kɔmpanii krokomɛi ni amɛ reps yaa shops yɛ routes anɔ. Etsuɔ nii kɛha van sales, pre-sales orders kɛ direct store delivery. Jeee ERP muu: ekɛ o accounting loo ERP system bɔɔ he yɛ API nɔ. Managers kpɛɔ yiŋ yɛ nɔ ni rep fɛɛ rep nyɛɔ efeɔ he, tamɔ discount ni ekɛhaa, nihɔɔmɔ yɛ jara ni ato lɛ shishi loo customers hee ni ewoɔ mli.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Mɛni ji srɔtofeemɔ ni yɔɔ van sales kɛ pre-sales teŋ?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Yɛ van sales mli lɛ, rep lɛ kɛ stock nyiɛɔ, ekɛ nibii haa, efeɔ invoice ni ebuaa shika yɛ sara kome mli. Yɛ pre-sales mli lɛ, rep lɛ heɔ order, ni warehouse lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ baa sɛɛ mli. FieldSales tsuɔ nii kɛha enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, no hewɔ kɔmpani nyɛɔ ekɛ cash vans tsuɔ nii yɛ routes komɛi anɔ ni eheɔ orders yɛ routes krokomɛi anɔ. Yɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, invoice, shika ni abua kɛ customers anyɔmɔ yɔɔ system kome mli, ni managers naa amɛ yɛ reports kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni makwɛ van ko akɔntaa yɛ gbi lɛ naagbee?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales tsɔɔ bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ van fɛɛ van mli: enyiɛ awo mli, enyiɛ ahɔɔ, enyiɛ akɛku sɛɛ kɛ enyiɛ eshwɛ. Kɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ to nɔ ni okane diɛŋtsɛ, ŋma srɔtofeemɔ fɛɛ akɛ tsakemɔ ni aŋma, ni kɛ nibii ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ku kɛya warehouse shi kome. Van lɛ baaje shishi wɔsɛ kɛ akɔntaa ni he tse ni ole.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Mɛɛ hardware van sales rep hiaa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android loo iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printer lɛ, kɛji osumɔ pɛ (optional): ehaa rep lɛ nyɛɔ ekɛ invoice loo receipt ni aprint lɛ haa customer lɛ. FieldSales jeee hardware hɔɔlɔ, ni printer brand ko pɔtɛɛ hiaaa. Managers kɛ kɔmputa loo fon browser fɛɛ browser tsuɔ web dashboard lɛ nii.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales nyɛɔ ekɛ wɔ accounting system bɔɔ he?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Hɛɛ. FieldSales haa API ni haa o accounting loo ERP system nyɛɔ ekɛ platform lɛ tsakeɔ customers, nibii, invoices, receipts kɛ stock ni yaa kɛ ni baa he saji. O team loo integrator kɛ API documentation lɛ feɔ bɔmɔ lɛ.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales yɛ Maji Amli: Shika, Tax kɛ E-Invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales tsuɔ nii kɛha distributors yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli. Kwɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ shika, tax kɛ e-invoicing shihilɛ yɛ table kome mli.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales sɔmɔɔ distribution kɔmpanii yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli. Kɔmpani fɛɛ kɔmpani halaa emaŋ, emaŋ shika kɛ tax rate yɛ settings lɛ mli, ni invoice, receipt kɛ reports nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ. Maŋ nɔyeli e-invoicing integration tsuɔ nii yɛ Saudi Arabia pɛ. Yɛ maji krokomɛi fɛɛ amli lɛ, eyɔɔ kɛji obi. Table ni yɔɔ shishi nɛɛ tsɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ shika, tax loo VAT rate ni akɛtsuɔ nii daa, kɛ kɛji maŋ nɔyeli e-invoicing integration tsuɔ nii loo eyɔɔ kɛji obi.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Wɔfiɔ Phase 2 integration kɛ ZATCA Fatoora platform lɛ sɛɛ
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Kɔmpani fɛɛ kɔmpani woɔ shika kɛ tax rate yɛ kɔmpani lɛ diɛŋtsɛ settings lɛ mli. Rates ni yɔɔ table nɛɛ mli ji gbɛtsɔɔmɔ pɛ ni amɛnyɛɔ amɛtsakeɔ; kɛ o tax ŋaawolɔ kwɛ mlai ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ. Dash (—) tsɔɔ akɛ rate ni akɛtsuɔ nii daa ko bɛ table nɛɛ mli kɛha nakai maŋ lɛ.
strings.tierB.about.title: FieldSales he saji
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales feɔ cloud software kɛha distribution kɔmpanii ni kɛ sales reps tsuɔ nii yɛ gbɛ nɔ. Ato FieldSales shishi yɛ afi 2026 yɛ Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (egbɛi yɛ Arabik mli ji فيلد سيلز) ji cloud platform kɛha distribution kɛ wholesale kɔmpanii ni kɛ sales reps tsuɔ nii yɛ gbɛ nɔ. Ato FieldSales shishi yɛ afi 2026, ni eyɔɔ Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Esɔmɔɔ kɔmpanii yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli, ni kɔmpani fɛɛ kɔmpani woɔ emaŋ shika kɛ tax rate yɛ kɔmpani lɛ diɛŋtsɛ settings lɛ mli. Wɔ customers ji kɔmpanii ni kɛ reps hɔɔ nii ni amɛkɛ nibii yaa yɛ gbɛ nɔ: distributors, wholesalers kɛ manufacturers ni kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛ sales kaai tsuɔ nii.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Wɔfeɔ system kome ni kwɛɔ gbɛ nɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ: invoices ni rep lɛ kɛ efon printɔ, receipts kɛ customers anyɔmɔ, van stock nɔkwɛmɔ, routes kɛ sarai ni location kɛ mfonirii fata he, kɛ web dashboard kɛha managers. Rep app lɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ Android kɛ iPhone nɔ, etsuɔ nii kɛyaa nɔ kɛji internet bɛ, ni kɛji network ku esɛɛ ba lɛ, efeɔ sync. Kɔmpanii nyɛɔ amɛkɛ FieldSales bɔɔ amɛ accounting loo ERP system he yɛ API nɔ, no hewɔ ehiaaa ni aŋma gbɛ nɔ saji lɛ shii enyɔ.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Wɔwieɔ product lɛ he bɔ ni eji diɛŋtsɛ. Wɔfiɔ Phase 2 integration kɛ ZATCA Fatoora platform lɛ sɛɛ. Integration kɛ maŋ nɔyeli systems yɛ maji krokomɛi amli lɛ, eyɔɔ kɛji obi. App lɛ interface yɔɔ Arabik wiemɔ, Blɔfo, Frɛnshi, Tɔki wiemɔ kɛ Chaina wiemɔ mli; Ga bɛ mli. Kɛji ootao ni owie kɛ wɔ lɛ, bi quote, to kpee loo ŋma message kɛha wɔ yɛ WhatsApp nɔ.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Wie kɛ FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Wie kɛ FieldSales team lɛ: bi quote, to kpee loo wie kɛ wɔ yɛ WhatsApp nɔ yɛ field sales kɛ van sales software he.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Kɛɛ wɔ bɔ ni o reps hɔɔ nii ŋmɛnɛ kɛ nɔ ni ootao ni otsake. Bi quote, to kpee loo ŋma message kɛha wɔ yɛ WhatsApp nɔ, ni wɔ team lɛ mli mɔ ko baaha bo hetoo. Kɛha yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, customers ni yɔɔ momo lɛ nyɛɔ amɛkɛ channels nɛɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ nii. Ebaaye wɔbua kɛji okɛɛ wɔ o maŋ, o reps ayibɔ, kɛ kɛji amɛkɛ van hɔɔ nii, amɛheɔ orders loo amɛfeɔ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: To kpee kɛ wɔ team lɛ yɛ internet nɔ. Wɔbaatsɔɔ bo rep gbi kome yɛ app lɛ mli kɛ manager dashboard lɛ, kɛ nɔkwɛmɔnii ni bɛŋkɛ o nibii kɛ o routes, ni wɔbaaha o sanebimɔi ahetoo yɛ setup he.
